entityId.description: Filter to records about this entity.

authorityId.description: Filter to records asserted by this authority.

action.description: Filter to records for this action.

resource.description: Filter to records for this resource.

source.description: Which view to enumerate. Defaults to `registry`.

cursor.description: An opaque continuation token from a previous response's `nextCursor`; a responder MUST NOT accept a cursor it did not issue.

limit.description: The most items to return, at most 200; the responder chooses a default (50) and MAY return fewer.

Source.description: `registry` enumerates the trust registry itself; `local` enumerates the community's own record of what it published. They are different questions and a consumer MUST NOT treat one as a cache of the other.

entityId.description: The entity the record is about.

recordType.description: Record discriminator, as the trust registry states it.

recognized.description: Present on recognition records: whether the action+resource is recognised. Absent on other record types — absent is not `false`.

authorized.description: Present on authorization records: whether the action+resource authorization is confirmed. Absent on other record types — absent is not `false`.

Response.title: VTC Registry Records List — response payload

items.description: The matching records, in the maintainer's stable enumeration order.

source.description: Which view these items came from, echoed so a consumer never has to infer it from the request it thinks it sent.

nextCursor.description: Continuation token for the next page; pass it back as `cursor`. Absent on the last page — never `null`.
